title: Capability manifest, version 1
description: What one module (Aethern, VYRN, Sonic, or a future Rust binary) can do, and how to run it. Listed in aethern.json "capabilities"; read by `aethern caps`, `aethern call` and `aethern mcp`. A capability runs as: run + prefix (default: the id after the module name, split on dots) + the caller's arguments + the host's args.

run.description: argv prefix; {dir} is the manifest's folder

cwd.description: run in the project root (default) or the manifest's folder

does.description: one line: what an agent gets
